chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Cats and the Fiddle stranded in California; meeting Tatum and replacing Slim Gaillard
summary: The Cats and the Fiddle run out of work in California, he stays, meets Tatum, and takes Slim Gaillard's place when Slim is drafted; they jam nightly at Lovejoy's.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: ... When I got with Art Tatum out in California I had only been playing about a year and a half -- year, and seven months, somewhere like that. But you see those fellas when we got to California with Cite and the fiddle we got a few weeks work & then we didn't get any. And then we got a job to come back to the Apollo -- we had played there several times. All the way back from California to NY and pay your own fare, for a hundred and some dollars. The fare cost more than for me gettin back here. I just say, well look, I just stay out here. And that's when I met Tatum. We started playin', I got a few jobs, joined the union out there. And then Slim of Slim & Slam got put in the army. And Slim asked me to take his place, which was impossible. Nobody could take Slim Gaillard's place. But I was the only available guitarist there so you know we worked together and I did the best I could. ...

... We used to go to this place called Lovejoys and sit around and jam. We did it every night and the first thing you know there was a crowd. And then Tatum used to come down & play and we had the place jumpin'. The guy would give us a sandwich and maybe a drink. And we come to find out, even now and then we'd look, we see a chain at the door & a crowd of people outside. Now he's gettin' a turnover makin' a handful of money and we ain't gettin' a dime.
